mapper.select:
SELECT permission_id AS permissionId, permission_code AS permissionCode, permission_nm AS permissionNm, permission_dc AS permissionDc, permission_level AS permissionLevel, use_at AS useAt, crt_dt AS frstRegistPnttm, crt_id AS frstRegisterId, upd_dt AS lastUpdtPnttm, upd_id AS lastUpdusrId FROM tb_permission WHERE use_at = 'Y'
AND permission_nm ILIKE '%' || #{permissionNm} || '%'
AND permission_level = #{permissionLevel}
ORDER BY sort_ordr
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_permission ( permission_code, permission_nm, permission_dc, permission_level, use_at, crt_dt, crt_id, upd_dt, upd_id ) VALUES ( #{permissionCode}, #{permissionNm}, #{permissionDc}, #{permissionLevel}, #{useAt}, now(), #{frstRegisterId}, now(), #{lastUpdusrId} )
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(p.permission_level) = 'write' THEN 'write' WHEN MAX(p.permission_level) = 'read' THEN 'read' ELSE 'none' END AS permissionLevel FROM tb_role_menu_permission rmp INNER JOIN tb_menu m ON rmp.menu_id = m.menu_id INNER JOIN tb_authority a ON rmp.authority_id = a.authority_id INNER JOIN tb_permission p ON rmp.permission_id = p.permission_id WHERE a.authority_code = #{authorityCode} AND m.menu_url = #{menuUrl} AND rmp.use_at = 'Y' AND m.use_at = 'Y' AND p.use_at = 'Y'
